agencyName: Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners (TSBPE)
authorityRationale: TSBPE's own compilation of 22 TAC Part 17 (Chapters 361-367), dated March 13, 2026, on tsbpe.texas.gov. The cover marks it 'UNOFFICIAL VERSION' (the Texas Register/TAC is the official text). Read directly 2026-10-09: s365.1 sets license categories by individual and limits contracting to a Master Plumber who is an RMP; s367.9(a): a person or company shall not offer plumbing to the public 'unless the person or company has secured the services of at least one RMP holding a current Master Plumber License.'
reliabilityRationale: Official primary document from the licensing agency itself, verified by direct read on 2026-10-09.
